name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 3
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.3
source:
A few days after Sanae's debut celebration, Akira met Wave, a spellcaster also in pursuit of Meru.
Akira joined him, though he didn't much like Wave pointing out his magical inadequacies.
At the river in the forest, a silver-haired girl suddenly came at Akira with Wave in plain sight.

A fantasy visual novel game set in reality and virtual reality.

The story continues.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE135938.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
早苗庆祝首次亮相几天后，阿基拉遇到了同样追求梅鲁的施法者波。
阿基拉加入了他，尽管他不太喜欢波指出他魔法的不足之处。
森林里的河边，一名银发少女突然带着波向阿基拉走来。

一款以现实和虚拟现实为背景的奇幻视觉小说游戏。

故事还在继续。
